claims.evidence: Photo shows a mountain bike with suspension and disc brakes but cannot prove strength or durability.
Report states working condition of gears, brakes, and chain is not shown.
Age or year of manufacture is not readable in the photo; no receipt shown.
Report states working condition of gears and brakes is not shown.
Report does not mention rust; hidden rust cannot be ruled out from the described photo.
Brand and model name are not readable in the photo.

risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of the frame, especially welds and joints.

risks.risk: Gears or brakes do not work
risks.proof: Video of gear shifting through all gears and brake levers being applied while the wheel spins.
Close-up of chain and cassette, or a chain wear checker measurement.
Close-up of tire tread and sidewalls.

risks.risk: Parts have been repaired or replaced
risks.proof: Detailed photos of all components plus original purchase receipt.

risks.risk: Seller does not own the bike
risks.proof: Original purchase receipt or proof of ownership matching the seller's ID.
risks.if_unproven: as unsellable due to ownership risk.

proof_requests: Video of gear shifting and brake operation
Close-up photos of frame welds and joints
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls
Original purchase receipt or proof of ownership
Close-up of any brand or model markings
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a mountain bike with visible features, so a worst-case price can be set; seller claims about age, condition, and originality are not proven by the report.
